title: Full day Hiking Adventure
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness

Experience Suggestions: You should have a fair amount of hiking experience before attempting this hike or be in good physical condition. At a minimum, you should be able to walk roughly 10 miles on flat pavement, or 8 miles of uneven rolling terrain over the course of 7 hours. You should also be able to easily climb many flights of stairs over the duration of the hike. Some parts of trail are steep and hilly, placing additional stress on areas of the body not impacted by level terrain. Not recommended for those with cardiac or respiratory issues/illness. May be difficult for those with severe joint issues.
policies: Participation waiver signature required prior to departure.
If you have any dietary restrictions, please let us know and we will accommodate you with a different snack option.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is the #1 option for individuals seeking a full-day adventure with a comprehensive variety of features found in the Alaskan wild. This tour provides endless possibilities for photography, a hearty challenge, and immense reward. We can make this as easy or difficult as you like, and can be tailored to your interests! Peak bagging or an easy to moderate stroll through the endless Alaskan wilderness - your choice!
